facts.fact: 开章：Angelica 骑 Yvri（锁在 Deia 熔炉火山里的始祖双足飞龙）越过 Dorso Ridge 练三音空中开门——three-note bar = two lower tones + an A-sharp。
facts.anchor: Angelica Mardova savored the stinging wind as the wyvern beneath her flapped his wings to soar higher.

facts.fact: 成功：跳门→quintessence 虚空里复唱三音→第二扇门开在 Vaega 灰天上空→坠回撞上 Yvri 背——「I did it!」；若 Dante 的 Conjuration 不成，这算是抵达 Solara 的备援路线。
Yvri 体内藏 Deia 的 crux/fulcrum——Azuna 之行本为挖出它，结果发现「proximity worked just fine」；她额上的第三眼是从神身上剜下来的。
facts.anchor: Her plan in going to Azuna had been to find Deia’s fulcrum

facts.fact: 水门练习失控线：门开一寸再一寸——「I need more. / More.」——漩涡甩出高浪扑向海岸镇；Yvri 一声鸣叫把浪劈向礁石无人区；Deia 手印疤刺痛、Azuna 以来神未再开口。
归家：Cosima 持练习剑偷袭——Angelica 拢衣中水汽凝成冰匕首贴上她颈侧；Cosima 练剑为防身（despotic warlords or estranged brothers），已搬进 Angelica 房。
facts.anchor: Not my fault someone’s one with the elements

facts.fact: 纪念碑：Ueda 家族名列被 Nanbu Daiji 雇刺客灭门的帝系之首——继母 Miko 带双胞胎 Eiko/Kikou 祭扫；Angelica「She did. She didn't. She had no right to.」；Bushan Takenaka 保护 child empresses 的消息未至。
facts.anchor: A gleaming plaque named the branches of the Azunese imperial family

facts.fact: Adela 赠新小提琴并两度道歉——「trying to take what was yours. What your father gave you」；旧琴是父亲所赠、曾为抗 Deia 而毁。
facts.anchor: But I do regret trying to take what was yours.

facts.fact: 演奏收束：火之门 rattled but stayed shut——为 Eiko/Cosima/Kikou、为亡父、为两位母亲而奏；Angelica 立誓唯一还要毁灭的只有神本身。
facts.anchor: the only thing she had left to destroy was the god herself.
